facts.business: Salem Erode Investments Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending activities including gold loans, retail credit, and MSME lending, operating through a network of 34 branches in Tamil Nadu and Odisha.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company is confident that its existing capacities and investments would serve well to expand its businesses throughout India in coming years.
Preparing to open additional branches in the coming months to further strengthen its regional presence.

key_risks: Competitive Landscape intensifying from banks, fintechs, digital lenders
Recovery and Legal Challenges in unsecured lending and small-ticket loans
Concentration of bank funding among higher-rated NBFCs
Interconnectedness between banks and NBFCs requiring stronger governance
facts.related_party_note: Holding company is ICL Fincorp Limited; company is moving beyond its current positioning under the umbrella of its holding company.
